evidence: User-provided Kaggle traceback; original remote partial files have not been independently inspected
update_count_basis: Trace fails during adapter construction, before optimizer creation or training loop
error_message: Found an incompatible version of torchao. Found version 0.10.0, but only versions above 0.16.0 are supported
cause: PEFT's optional TorchAO dispatcher checks the installed TorchAO version before falling back to the ordinary linear-layer LoRA dispatcher
fix: Remove unused torchao in the disposable Kaggle runtime and verify is_torchao_available() is False in a fresh Python process. Keep all pinned training packages, data, model revision and hyperparameters unchanged.
retry_policy: Rerun the training notebook cell to create a fresh output directory; retain the failed directory and do not upload it as a completed training run
